# std/eq

> == : equal

truck [std](../std.md) · [source](../../../registry/std/eq.pkg) · translated by [bintables/eq](../bintables/eq.md) · translated by [ctables/eq](../ctables/eq.md) · translated by [webtables/eq](../webtables/eq.md)

Equal: compares two values of the same type and gives a `bool`.

```
print 3 == 3          // true
print "ab" == "ab"    // true: strings compare by content
print p == null
```

Pointers compare by address, strings by content. Infix, precedence 30,
left-associative.

## Syntax

Kind: `infix`, precedence 30, left-associative

```
{left: expr T} == {right: expr T} -> bool
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `left` | expression | `T` |
| `right` | expression | `T` |

Produces: `bool`
